title: Kahran & Divya on the Learnings from Meghana Srinivas & Samhita Arni
summary: Kahran and Divya reflect on their interviews with founder Meghana Srinivas and author Samhita Arni, pulling out the threads that have stayed with them — rituals, identity, success expectations and what it means to feel multifaceted instead of fragmented. They get into why 'just good enough' creative paths leave you measuring yourself against benchmarks meant for the path you left behind, and the new shape of startup-as-default career.
topics: startup as the new investment banking

intents.display: to think through identity and success after meeting two indian creators
